The '''Dega system''' was a [[Binary star/Legends|binary star]] [[Star system/Legends|system]]<ref name="BoP" /> located in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dega]].<ref name="PotG3" /> A [[Battle of Dega|space battle]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took place in the Dega system during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="BoP" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Background graphics in the game ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter]]'' during the 14th rebel mission in the [[Spreading the Rebellion|rebel campaign]] of the ''Balance of Power'' expansion, which takes place in the Dega system, depict the system with a binary sun.<ref name="BoP" />
